expect_red: opening the flyout moves the DAG pane out from under it, rather than leaving it underneath

mutations.contract: While the panel is open the page yields the room -- `.tv` starts at the panel's right edge and the nav rail stands down -- which is the only reason the drawing can be beside it at all.
mutations.note: This reverses, on purpose, what topology.css argued until 2026-09-16 ("opening it cannot shrink or reflow the DAG pane by construction"). That invariant was right for a RIGHT-docked panel and is exactly what made a left-docked one useless: the drawing is 90-262px wide at the pane's left edge and the panel's floor is 560. The mutation removes the shift, which is the pre-review build; the drawing then sits under the panel and the adjacency checks go red. Its twin is `flyout-close-restores-the-page`.
